claims.assertion: Mari warns that alien disclosure or a staged invasion could justify new censorship and persecution of starseeds, echoing panic-driven social division.

claims.qualifiers: Mari presents this as a possible future scenario, not a prediction; she says awareness could make it less likely.

claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
